d: Lalitha comes from a poor family who struggles to put food on the table due to her conservative father. However, when their financial situation worsens and needs grow, she turns to prostitution.
After a feared gangster dies, a humble look-alike infiltrates his criminal empire.
Pushpa, the daughter of a landlord, falls in love with Raja, who works in a circus troupe. When her father refuses to accept their union, she decides to elope with her lover.
